scope: Maps a research region and platform type to concrete platforms, then resolves each platform against the reviewed connector registry. The map encodes availability, not permission: every enabled platform still needs study-specific access, policy, and data-rights review before collection.

platform_types.forum: Long-form discussion communities, Q&A threads, and interest boards
platform_types.social: Short-post social feeds and public conversations
platform_types.video: Video platforms with searchable comments and metadata
platform_types.ecommerce: Marketplace product reviews, Q&A, and transaction-linked feedback
platform_types.crowdfunding: Crowdfunding campaigns, creator updates, and backer-facing records

zhihu.status_note: No reviewed open-source connector yet; manual lawful routes only, recorded as an evidence gap.

weibo.status_note: No reviewed open-source connector yet; official open platform APIs serve account holders' own data, not third-party research.

bilibili.status_note: No reviewed open-source connector yet; treat as an evidence gap rather than a scraping target.

modian.status_note: No reviewed open-source connector yet; small manual public examples remain discovery-only.
